Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SILVER CLIP SET 

PART III RACK, CLIP 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for rack for keeping silver clips used in 
neurosurgery. 

2. Shape arid Oimen^tttik^A^ shown in Fig. 1. Rack may also be double range type, if required 
by the purchaser. 

2.1 The tolerance on various dimensions shall be permitted as given blow: 

a) ± 0'1 mm for dimensions up to 2 mm, 

b) ± 0*5 mm for dimensions above 2 mm and up to 5 mm, 

c) ± 1-0 mm for dimensions above 5 mm and up to 20 mm, 

d) ± 2'5 mm for dimensions above 20 mm and up to 100 mm, and 

e) ± 5'0 mm for dimensions above 100 mm and up to 200 mm. 

3. Material — Various components of rack shall be made from stainless steel of compositions as 
indicated below: 



Component 
Rack and base 

Rack cover 

Screws 



Stainless Steel Conforming to 

Designation 20Cr13of IS : 6603-1972 'Specification for 
stainless steel, bars and flats'. 

Designation 20Cr13 of IS : 6911-1972 'Specification for 
stainless steel plate, sheet and strip'. 

Designation 20CM3 of IS : 6603-1972 Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats 1 or IS: 6528-1972 
'Specification for stainless steel wire 1 . 



4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The rack shall be formed by machining and cutting the slots precisely according to dimensions 
shown in Fig. 1. The rack shall be firmly affixed to its base with the help screws. 

4.2 The rack cover shall be neither too tight nor too loose, when secured in position and shall be 
able to slide freely when all the slots are full with clips. 

4.3 All the edges and surfaces shall be finished smooth and free from burs, pits, sharp edges, 
cracks and other defects. All components shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance — Subject all components of the rack to boilling and autoclaving test in 
accordance with IS: 7531-1975 'Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of 
stainless steel surgical instruments'. There shall be no sign of corrosion after the test. 

6. Marking — Each rack, on its base, shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or 
recognized trade-mark, the country of manufacturer and the words ' SS f or 'Stainless Steel'. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — Each rack shall be wrapped in a moisture-proof paper/polyethylene bag and packed 
in a cardboard carton. Alternatively, packing may be done as agreed to between the purchaser and 
the supplier. 



Adopted 10 August 1981
